question: Assume today is 2026-09-08. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the number of births registered in Taiwan in September 2026, as reported in the Ministry of the Interior's monthly household registration statistics.

target.definition: Number of live births registered in Taiwan during the calendar month of September 2026, as reported in the Ministry of the Interior's monthly household registration statistics.

inputs.name: taiwan_population
inputs.description: Mid-2026 population of Taiwan (excluding foreign residents).

provenance.rationale: Taiwan's population has been declining slightly from a 2019 peak of about 23.6 million; 23.4 million is a reasonable mid-2026 estimate.

inputs.name: annual_birth_rate
inputs.description: Annual crude birth rate (live births per 1,000 population) in Taiwan for 2026.

provenance.rationale: Taiwan's birth rate has fallen sharply, from about 7.0 in 2020 to roughly 5.5–6.0 in recent years; 5.5 is a plausible 2026 value.

inputs.name: people_per_birth_rate_unit
inputs.description: Number of people corresponding to one unit of the crude birth rate (per 1,000 people).

provenance.rationale: The crude birth rate is defined per 1,000 people, so this conversion factor is exactly 1,000.
September always has 30 days.

inputs.name: days_in_year
inputs.description: Number of days in a year.

provenance.rationale: Standard year length; 2026 is not a leap year.

inputs.name: annual_births
inputs.description: Total live births in Taiwan in 2026.

provenance.rationale: Recent annual births: about 165,000 in 2020, 153,000 in 2021, 139,000 in 2022, 135,000 in 2023, and likely lower in 2024–2026; 130,000 is a central estimate.

inputs.name: september_share_of_annual_births
inputs.description: Fraction of annual births that occur in September.

provenance.rationale: September has 30 days (8.22% of the year), but birth seasonality in Taiwan typically shows a slight September peak; 8.3% is a reasonable central value.

inputs.name: monthly_births_2025
inputs.description: Average number of births per month in Taiwan in 2025.

provenance.rationale: If 2025 annual births were around 132,000, the monthly average would be about 11,000; this is consistent with recent trends.

inputs.name: monthly_change_factor
inputs.description: Factor by which monthly births in September 2026 differ from the 2025 monthly average.

provenance.rationale: Births have been declining by roughly 2–5% per year, but September may have a slight seasonal bump; a factor near 1 with wide uncertainty is appropriate.

inputs.name: women_20_39
inputs.description: Number of women aged 20–39 in Taiwan in 2026.

provenance.rationale: Taiwan's population is about 23.4 million; women aged 20–39 make up roughly 13% of the population, giving about 3 million.

inputs.name: annual_births_per_woman_20_39
inputs.description: Annual live births per woman aged 20–39 in Taiwan.

provenance.rationale: With about 130,000 annual births and 3 million women aged 20–39, the ratio is about 0.043; this reflects the low fertility rate.

inputs.name: september_share_of_year
inputs.description: Fraction of the year that September represents, adjusted for birth seasonality.

provenance.rationale: September has 30 days (8.22% of the year), but birth seasonality may make it slightly higher; 8.3% is a central estimate.

inputs.name: months_per_year
inputs.description: Number of months in a year.

provenance.rationale: There are 12 months in a year.

paths.description: Estimate annual births from population and crude birth rate, then allocate to September using a seasonal share.

paths.description: Count women of childbearing age and multiply by the annual birth rate per woman, then scale to September.
